pr.body:
## Summary

Vendor the actionable gap ledger into the Genesis demo dashboard.

## Tickets

Fixes #65

## Changes

- separate present implementation work from operating-evidence work
- list criteria ready for ongoing Type II observation
- show the CPA-controlled observation-period gap explicitly
- link each gap directly to its evidence page

## Test Plan

- `cargo test --manifest-path .shadow/site/Cargo.toml --locked`
- rerun the main-branch deterministic dashboard and inspect the deployed artifact
